intro: Harvesting the Harvesters is a local quest in Westfall where players assist Ozwin Ironsprocket, a visiting gnome tinkerer trapped inside a stable at Saldean's Farm. After underestimating the ferocity of the region's haywire harvest golems, Ozwin requires salvaged mechanical components to construct an escape contraption.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!
If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's a mess out there, friend! Did you collect the parts I need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!
